decision: Group these source university identities under University of Toronto for the final one-university doctoral register; retain distinct campus labels and all source IDs and do not duplicate Rotman/MIE doctorates onto each faculty campus.

sources.evidence: Central University of Toronto site explicitly calls University of Toronto Mississauga its second-largest division and describes it as campus with departments and undergraduate/interdisciplinary graduate programs.
Central University of Toronto site lists Scarborough alongside Mississauga and St. George under Campuses and describes University of Toronto Scarborough as campus.
Central University of Toronto convocation explicitly states graduating students from all three campuses attend common convocation at Convocation Hall and celebrates U of T Class of 2026.

limitations: These sources establish institutional parent and common university convocation; programme-specific administrative hosts remain individually sourced in doctoral programme proposals. They do not imply each campus separately offers every doctorate.
